title: Your keyboard back — and a live content plane

highlights.text: Hotkeys are app-scoped now — the system-wide ⌘T/⌘K/⌘M/⌘, grab is gone; browsers get Cmd+T back
Pulse lands: signed Atlas catalogue + fleet kill-switches, verified end-to-end

notesMarkdown: Removes the OS-global hotkey registration (tauri-plugin-global-shortcut) that stole ⌘T/⌘K/⌘M/⌘, from every other app while HQ ran. Ships the U2 Pulse client: signed content snapshots, the Atlas catalogue feed, and remote kill-switches.
